title: UI professor named a 2026 Mellon Emerging Faculty Leader
summary_en: Ashley Howard, University of Iowa assistant professor of history, has been named a 2026 Mellon Emerging Faculty Leader. The recognition comes from the Andrew W. Mellon Foundation, the nation’s leading funder of the arts, culture, and humanities.
title_cn: UI professor named a 2026 Mellon Emerging Faculty Leader

title: UI to raze Halsey Hall, seek approval to begin planning IMU parking ramp expansion
summary_en: The University of Iowa is seeking permission from the Iowa Board of Regents to begin planning a modernization and expansion of the Iowa Memorial Union Parking Ramp, making it easier and safer for people to drive and walk in a busy area of campus.
title_cn: UI to raze Halsey Hall, seek approval to begin planning IMU parking ramp expansion

title: UI College of Dentistry seeks to expand lab space, make room for research growth
summary_en: The University of Iowa is seeking permission from the Iowa Board of Regents to proceed with planning renovation and expansion of research laboratory space in the Dental Science Building in the College of Dentistry, where external research funding nearly doubled in the past five years.
title_cn: UI College of Dentistry seeks to expand lab space, make room for research growth
